_doc: Certified 2026 results, entered by hand. Key: race id ("AZ-04", "AK-AL", "AZ-S"). status: "certified" (the state certified the winner) or "runoff" (the state certified that no one won outright; winners = the two in the runoff). winners: FEC candidate ids. source: who certified it ("the Arizona Secretary of State"), sourceUrl: the certification or official canvass, date: YYYY-MM-DD it was certified. Never enter a result from news reports or unofficial returns. Winners sworn in on Jan. 3, 2027 are picked up from congress-legislators without an entry here. See design/races/README.md.
